usage: The word '兩個' is used to count or specify the number two of something.
It always precedes a noun to indicate there are two items or units of the noun.
In Cantonese, '兩個' is the common way to say 'two' when counting objects.
You can use '兩個' to refer to both people and things in everyday conversation.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 jiu3 loeng5 go3 ping4 gwo2.
keoi5 dei6 daai3 zo2 loeng5 go3 gau2 lei4.
ngo5 jau5 loeng5 go3 man6 tai4 soeng2 man6 nei5.
examples.meaning: I have two questions to ask you.

examples.jyutping: keoi5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 go3 bui1.
